# Protocol fixtures

`native-v2-2.7.8-classification.subvisionproj` is a reduced and path-redacted fixture derived from a SaigeVision V2 2.7.8 UI export. Its field names and nesting are unchanged; only project/file counts, names, IDs, paths and descriptive text were minimized or anonymized.

Keep this fixture in the repository. Tests must not depend on ignored files under `work/` or on machine-specific sample paths.
